info.title: Aether AI — Knowledge Assistant API
info.description: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation chatbot powered by Google Gemini

post.description:
A new access token for the refresh cookie set at sign-in. 401 when it is missing, expired,
revoked, not recorded (issued before Sprint 8), or names a user who is gone.

Revoke the refresh token the cookie holds and remove the cookie, so a reloaded page is
signed out and the token cannot be used again. The access token the client holds still works
until it expires (at most settings.access_token_minutes).

Revoke every refresh token of the signed-in user, on every device, and remove this
browser's cookie. Each other device is signed out when its access token next needs renewing,
at most settings.access_token_minutes later.

get.description: Who the access token belongs to (F8): a reloaded page knows its token but not the name.

Health check for monitoring and load balancers. Status only: it is public, so it says
nothing about the version, the uptime or anyone's documents (S10).

post.description:
Upload a document: PDF, Word, text, Markdown, CSV or Excel. 202: it is accepted and read in
the background; GET /documents/{document_id} reports when it is ready or why it failed (R12).

The token is checked before any of the body is read (S4).

delete.description: Clear all documents from the vector store for the user.

get.description: List detailed information of all ingested documents.

One document and how reading it went: "processing", then "ready" or "failed" with an error
(R12). 404 for an id that is not yours. Declared after /documents/detailed, which it would
otherwise shadow.

delete.description: Delete one document, by the id the detailed list gives it. 404 for an id that is not yours.

post.description: Ask a question — answers are grounded in uploaded documents.

Thumbs up (1), down (-1) or neither (0) for one answer, named by the turn_id it came with
(F10). 404 for a turn that is not the user's.
Streaming endpoint — returns the answer token-by-token using SSE.

200.description: Server-sent events, one per `data:` line: tokens in order, then one done or one error event.

schema.title: Response 200 Chat Stream Api V1 Chat Stream Post

post.description: Clear conversation memory for a session.

get.description: The user's conversations, most recently used first, each titled by its first question.

Every turn of one of the user's conversations, oldest first, with the sources and tool
shown with each answer. Empty for a session with no turns, or one that is not the user's.

patch.description:
Give one of the user's conversations a name, shown in place of its first question.
404 for a conversation that is not the user's, or has no turns yet.

delete.description:
Delete one of the user's conversations: every turn, its feedback and its name. 404 for a
conversation that is not the user's.

post.description:
Share one of the user's conversations. Sharing it again gives the same link. 404 for a
conversation that is not the user's, or has no turns yet.

get.description: Whether one of the user's conversations is shared, and by which link.

delete.description: Withdraw the link. It stops working at once; sharing again makes a new one.

get.description:
A shared conversation, for anyone who has its link: no sign-in. 404 for a link that was
never made or has been withdrawn.

AgentStep.title: AgentStep
AgentStep.description: One tool call of an agent answer, in the order they ran (Sprint 8, item 2).

DocumentRecord.title: DocumentRecord
DocumentRecord.description: A document as the detailed list gives it: its status, and the hash that spots a duplicate upload.

DocumentStatus.title: DocumentStatus
DocumentStatus.description: One document in a user's library, and how reading it went.

DoneEvent.title: DoneEvent
DoneEvent.description: The last event of an answer.

ErrorEvent.title: ErrorEvent
ErrorEvent.description: The last event of an answer that could not be finished. Nothing of it was saved.

Me.title: Me
Me.description: The signed-in user, for a page that was reloaded and knows only its token.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: A reply that only says what happened.

SessionRename.title: SessionRename
SessionRename.description: A new name for a conversation (Sprint 8, item 3).

ShareState.title: ShareState
ShareState.description: Whether one of the user's conversations is shared. The page that shows it is /shared/{token}.

SharedConversation.title: SharedConversation
SharedConversation.description: A conversation as anyone with its link sees it. It says nothing about whose it is.

SharedTurn.title: SharedTurn
SharedTurn.description:
One question and its answer in a shared conversation: what its owner saw, without the
turn's id or the owner's rating.

Source.title: Source
Source.description: A passage an answer came from, as it is shown beside the answer.

TokenEvent.title: TokenEvent
TokenEvent.description: A piece of the answer, in order.

Turn.title: Turn
Turn.description: One question and its answer, as they were shown.

UploadResponse.title: UploadResponse
UploadResponse.description:
An accepted upload. It is read in the background: GET /documents/{document_id} says when
it is ready, or why it failed (R12).

Usage.title: Usage
Usage.description: What an answer cost (Sprint 8, item 1). Tokens are counted, never priced.

UsageStage.title: UsageStage
UsageStage.description: One stage of an answer: rewrite, retrieve, summarize, answer; or agent, document_search.
